# scripts/Visual/Posture.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Posture.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Skeleton modifier for gaze, hips/chest counter-turn, kicks, breathing, weight shifts, and injury posture.
Humanoid creates it; callers update fields each frame. Rotations use the person's own axes, independent of bone frames.

Base: `SkeletonModifier3D`. Registered class: `none`.

### _turn

```gdscript
func _turn(skeleton: Skeleton3D, bone: StringName, axis: Vector3, angle: float) -> void
```

[Source:134](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Posture.gd#L134)

Turns `bone` (and so all below it) by `angle` about `axis` (skeleton
space) through its own joint.
